summary: Learn the keys to effective team leadership in this Performance Training Course. Transform your approach and inspire your team to achieve outstanding results.
lede: Team performance training helps leaders responsible for others’ work align team activity with clear goals. It covers assessing team maturity and psychological safety, adapting leadership to members’ competence and commitment, and using OKRs, GROW coaching and feedback to guide performance and development. For team leads, project managers and department heads, it also addresses clarifying responsibilities, resolving conflict and coordinating hybrid work.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who are directly responsible for the output, engagement, and development of others in a corporate environment.
modules: Leading in a Hybrid and Digital World
prerequisites: Participants should hold a current leadership role or be scheduled to transition into a management position within six months. Basic familiarity with organizational reporting structures is recommended.
